evidence.title: Maps do not show link between coronavirus and 5G wireless
evidence.snippet_en: AP News rated False the claim that maps show a correlation between COVID-19 cases and 5G wireless installations, finding no link between the virus and 5G.

evidence.title: 5G is not accelerating the spread of the new coronavirus – Full Fact
evidence.snippet_en: Full Fact debunked claims that 5G networks are responsible for the rapid spread of the novel coronavirus, noting there is no evidence linking 5G to the virus.
evidence.rating_text: This is not true. There is no evidence that 5G WiFi networks are linked to the new coronavirus.
